name: Sanctions Territory Reference
notice: Comprehensive territorial sanctions programmes only. Not a list of designated persons; does not cover sectoral or list-based measures; not legal advice. Verify against the cited primary source before relying on any record.

Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations (31 C.F.R. Part 560)

territories.official_name: North Korea (Democratic People's Republic of Korea)
territories.designating_instrument: North Korea Sanctions Regulations (31 C.F.R. Part 510)
Executive Order 13338 (2004); Syrian Sanctions Regulations (31 C.F.R. Part 542)
territories.cfr_part: 31 C.F.R. Part 542 (removed from the C.F.R. effective August 26, 2025)
territories.mismatch_note: Comprehensive Syria sanctions under the Syrian Sanctions Regulations ended effective July 1, 2025. List-based measures continue under Promoting Accountability for Assad and Regional Stabilization Sanctions (PAARSS) and other authorities for designated persons and regional actors — outside this reference's comprehensive-territory scope.

The designation follows the Crimea region; geolocation products variously return ISO 3166-2 subdivision UA-43, country-level UA, or inconsistent labels. Implementers must document which signal they treat as authoritative.

territories.official_name: Certain regions of Ukraine (Donetsk and Luhansk oblasts, non-government controlled areas)
territories.mismatch_note: The legal perimeter follows non-government controlled areas of Donetsk and Luhansk oblasts, while ISO 3166-2 codes UA-14 and UA-09 describe entire oblasts. Blocking at oblast granularity over-blocks relative to the designation; blocking at country UA under-blocks relative to oblast-level signals. No configuration is strictly correct — only a documented choice.

territories.designating_instrument: Executive Order 13067 (November 3, 1997); Sudanese Sanctions Regulations (31 C.F.R. Part 538)
territories.terminating_instrument: Executive Order 13761 (January 13, 2017), as amended by Executive Order 13804 (July 11, 2017)
territories.cfr_part: 31 C.F.R. Part 538 (removed from the C.F.R. June 29, 2018)
territories.mismatch_note: Darfur Sanctions Regulations (31 C.F.R. Part 546) remain in force. Sudan is not sanctions-free; only the former comprehensive Sudanese Sanctions Regulations programme reflected in Part 538 was revoked.
